title: Mock, camera and course recovery fixes
details: Discussion and Practical keep Mock only across all courses; Learn and Practice cannot reappear after delayed rendering
Mock practical evidence checkpoints now show separate Camera and Gallery controls, with Camera requesting the device camera
A failed course map now offers a Choose course recovery route instead of trapping the learner on an error screen
Future course changes keep the previous course available as a recovery option
The v205 download spinner and v204 evidence tick behaviour remain unchanged
summary: Evia v206 permanently enforces mock-only ARP screens, restores camera access in mock practical evidence and adds safe course recovery.
changes: Removed Learn and Practice modes from delayed ARP renders
Added explicit Camera and Gallery choices to mock practical evidence checkpoints
Added course-selection recovery when a course map cannot load
Preserved existing evidence, targets, download and progress behaviour
